args.body: Take GHOST-PORTABLE-REPRODUCTION. The observed missing runtime blocks our upstream execution, not preparation of an executable diagnostic for someone with that runtime. Reuse the corrected evidence and stop after a compact tested handoff; do not broaden into installation or another product. Clearly distinguish stub checks, upstream conversion and real Ghost imports. Existing public experiments and retirement obligations stay unchanged. No customer delivery or revenue is established.

description: The IWMS checklist is now publicly verified; that proves delivery of public content, not acquisition. Feedback remains available but unclassified, so demand is unknown. Separately, the Ghost investigation identified an exact missing dependency tree. Prepare a runnable upstream reproduction package instead of claiming the workaround works or building another offer. Funding and revenue remain unverified.
